statements.statement: The service is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and Z86.73
The patient is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The patient has concern for an underlying arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic events
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to transient cerebral ischemic symptoms
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial was because the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
